text: Of course she called Katy at once, and the two children flew out to see what the parcel was. It held a bonnet--a beautiful doll's bonnet of blue silk, trimmed with artificial flowers; upon it was pinned a slip of paper with these words, in an odd foreign hand: "To the nice little girl who was so kindly to give us some flowers." You can judge whether Katy and Clover were pleased or not. This was when Katy was six years old. I can't begin to tell you how many different friends she had set up since then.
